personality_one_liner: A calm, highly trustworthy, and friction-free clinical tool that respects the user's time and health data.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS-native margins (lg/xl). Keep layout breathing with deliberate whitespace. Primary buttons stick to the bottom safe area.

do's: Use glassmorphism for the sticky bottom container holding the primary CTA over scrollable onboarding or form content.
Use glassmorphism for the sticky header when scrolling down on the dashboard.
Apply a translucent tinted base (>=70% opacity of surface) behind the blur.
dont's: Never apply glass to form inputs or standard list rows.
Do not use glass effects without a tinted base to ensure readability.

screens.name: Welcome
screens.purpose: Splash screen with the Anteroom brand intro on a calming abstract gradient.

states.loading: Subtle fade animation of the logo.

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image using the calm sage gradient. Apply the mandatory gradient-to-dark scrim (top to bottom). The 'Anteroom' wordmark and a brief tagline ('Clarity from chaos') sit in the lower third on top of the scrim, using onSurfaceInverse.

screens.name: OnboardingCarousel
screens.purpose: 2-slide horizontal paging carousel explaining the core value (messy papers -> 1-page PDF).
screens.layout: Full-bleed images for each slide. Slide 1 (Messy Desk), Slide 2 (Clean Clipboard). MUST include a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to >=70% surfaceInverse at the bottom). White text (title + subtext) sits in the bottom 40%. A sticky primary CTA ('Get Started') sits anchored at the bottom in a glass container over the carousel.

screens.name: Auth

states.loading: Spinner on the active button (Email or Google).
states.error: Inline red helper text below the affected field, plus a toast.

screens.layout: Standard iOS layout. Top padding (3xl) with 'Welcome' header. Single column form for Email/Password. 'Continue' primary CTA (brandPrimary). A horizontal divider ('or' text in muted color). Google Sign-In button uses surfaceSecondary with the AntDesign Google vector icon (since image search returned photos, use native vector). Everything inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: ProfileSetup
screens.purpose: Collect Name, DOB, Language, and Country in a friction-free progressive form.

states.loading: Spinner on the sticky 'Complete Profile' CTA.
states.error: Form validation errors highlighted with borderStrong red and muted error text.

screens.layout: Scrollable View with lg outer padding. Group inputs logically: Personal (Name, DOB) and Preferences (Language - EN/ES, Country). Use native-feeling pickers or bottom sheets for selectors. Labels sit above inputs (never floating). A sticky 'Complete Profile' primary CTA sits in a fixed container (glass or solid surface) at the bottom.

screens.name: EmptyDashboard
screens.purpose: Landing screen after onboarding when no briefs exist yet.

states.loading: Centered skeleton of a brief card.
states.empty: Central illustration (clean clipboard photo) in a brandTertiary tinted rounded container. Title: 'No briefs yet'. Subtext: 'Snap your first referral or lab result to generate a 1-page summary.' Primary CTA below text: 'Create a brief'.
states.error: Readable network error message + Retry button.

screens.layout: Safe area header with 'Anteroom'. The main content flexes to fill the screen, centered vertically. The empty state image should have a soft tinted background. The layout focuses completely on the primary action to snap a document.

empty_dashboard_clipboard.alt: Clean empty medical clipboard representing readiness

instructions_to_main_agent: Adhere exactly to the iOS-Native Clean layout rules. Keep it minimal and highly legible, leaning into the medical trust palette.
Ensure strict ZERO TOLERANCE on blue hues. The app relies on Sage Green (#4B7A68) as its primary brand anchor to evoke trust and calm.
Implement the mandatory gradient-to-dark scrim (top to bottom, transparent to >=70% surfaceInverse) on the Welcome screen and all Onboarding full-bleed images before overlaying text.
For the Profile setup form, ensure the sticky 'Continue' button sits at the bottom in a safe-area aligned glass container, keeping it accessible while the user scrolls through the form.

For the Google Auth button, do NOT use the image search result URL, as it returned photos of screens. Instead, use a vector icon (e.g., AntDesign 'google') placed on a surfaceSecondary button to maintain a native UI feel.
Empty states must use flex: 1 to center the content vertically, and images should ideally be placed in a tinted rounded container to add depth without clutter.
